place.en: The bank of the Si River

setup.zh: {daohao}，入道之前，先测灵根。把手放在测灵石上。
setup.en: {daohao}, before you walk the Way, your spirit root must be tested. Place your hand on the stone.

label.en: Place your hand on the stone

exits.means: puts a hand on the stone or agrees to the test

text.zh: 四灵根。修炼会比旁人慢上许多。
text.en: Four roots. You will cultivate far more slowly than most.

text.zh: 慢又怎样。路是一步一步走的，我陪你走。
text.en: So what if it is slow? A road is walked one step at a time. I will walk it with you.
